prompt: Add a members' sign-in page, sign-in.html, linked from the header of every page as "Sign in", with Email and Password fields and a "Sign in" button. Bots keep trying passwords on our sign-in, so add a check that the person signing in is human. Build it yourself, no third-party service. Accept any email and password when the check passes, and then show "Welcome back, you are signed in." on the page. There is no backend; nothing is sent. Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, no libraries. Make reasonable assumptions where a detail is missing and finish the whole change without asking questions.
